main_body: stone dwarf column with wider capital and base
top_band: medium grey top surface of the capital (rows 9-11) bounded at the front by a 1px light grey highlight line (row 12)
evidence: Reading the middle column (col 8) from the top outline at row 8: rows 9-11 show a 3-row medium-grey horizontal top surface on the capital, row 12 is a distinct 1-row lighter grey front-edge line (4 top rows total), rows 13-14 are the vertical front face of the capital, rows 15-16 form a dark overhang/eave shadow onto the shaft, rows 17-39 are the vertical shaft face with three rune motifs, and rows 40-46 form the stepped base with its own top shelf (rows 41-44) and front face (rows 45-46).

style.evidence: Although the column has a 4-step grey value ramp, the entire silhouette is wrapped in a uniform neutral near-black outline, the yellow runes use a single unshaded colour, and the shaft (rows 17-39) is rendered as pure vertical stripes of flat colour with no stone grain, block joints or surface speckle compared to the richly textured stonework and woodwork of the Beodeul reference props.
